headline: Meta fined $25 billion for data privacy violations
summary: Meta has been hit with a record $25 billion fine over misleading statements regarding user data privacy.
why: Meta is a leading technology conglomerate and social media titan whose revenue largely depends on targeted advertising and data processing practices.

impacts.name: Meta Platforms
impacts.why: A massive regulatory fine directly impacts the company's net income and profitability for the quarter.

why_moved: A multi-billion-dollar regulatory penalty directly reduces corporate profit margins and earnings, causing immediate reactions in market valuations.
